svg.title: Sensor readings and 90% forecast intervals in instrument units
svg.desc: Synthetic instrument readings versus equally spaced minutes. Forecasts from time 95 approach the fixed centre of ten instrument units; shading gives marginal central 90% reading intervals including latent-state, parameter and measurement uncertainty. The dashed line separates training from 24 future readings; the band is not a simultaneous path interval.
